comment: Per-site fixture list for the multi-site benchmark (task 3.5.7). Each entry pins ONE fixture module and the expectations its score is measured against. Expectations are declared HERE (data, versioned) — never hard-coded in the runner — so tightening a floor is a versioned contract change, not a code change. `expectedRoutes` / `minTriggers` / `minAssets` are FLOORS the engine must reach, counted from the fixture source: routes = distinct pathnames the site serves; triggers = data-cloner-trigger marks the explorer can earn from real buttons (conservatively below the raw button count, since form controls and selects are read directly, not clicked); assets = network-captured image entries with hash+localPath. `requiredDimensions` lists the rubric dimensions scored for the site; the omitted ones are not applicable (their weight renormalizes over the applicable set).

sites.name: multipage-static
sites.demonstrates: simple multi-page static site: route discovery across 4 plain pages, shared masthead, no client state

sites.name: astro-retail
sites.demonstrates: product grid + cards + PDP specs table + add-to-cart form + filter sidebar; network-captured product images that must survive into the generated project

sites.name: marshlight-docs
sites.demonstrates: documentation sidebar on every page, article body, API reference table, guide-tile repeated group

sites.name: northbrook-portal
sites.demonstrates: services table, filter bar form, booking form with multiple inputs, status chips, account sign-in form (all three buttons are submit controls inside forms — the explorer captures form-field evidence and never clicks form controls, so this site legitimately yields 0 trigger marks)

sites.name: stackline-stateful
sites.demonstrates: URL-hash routing + nested filter/pagination/sort state + localStorage persistence — deep application-state reconstruction (task 3.5.3)

sites.name: meridian-dock
sites.demonstrates: 3-pane dockable workspace with splitters + tab group (task 3.4.2); state restoration = workspace augmentation applied and pane geometry preserved across reload

sites.name: nimbus-visual
sites.demonstrates: inline SVG chart + hero art, two canvas charts (snapshot treatment), CSS map mock with markers + toggle — complex visual content (task 3.5.4)
